item.description:

Limited entered a definitive agreement to acquire a 60% equity interest in Brightray Science Inc., a modular data center solutions provider. Consideration consists of newly issued BUUU Class A shares valued at $20.00 per share plus a promissory note convertible into up to 10 million BUUU shares, subject to performance adjustments and a 19.99% ownership cap. Sellers retain 40% of Brightray; BUUU holds a call option on the remaining interest over three years. Concurrently, BUUU announced a private placement of units at $10.00 each expected to raise over $60 million, and plans to relocate its headquarters to Singapore. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.

About: BUUU Group Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides design, planning and production of face-to-face event in Hong Kong. The company operates through Event Management and Stage Production segments. The company curates and manages a range of events, including cultural, artistic, recreational, and corporate promotions. It also offers event management services, such as design and planning, project management, and on-site supervision.
